Subject: BrightKey vendor setup — initial packet

Hi Olga / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our onboarding checklist, attached are BrightKey Systems' W-9 and a PO contact sheet so your team can initiate the vendor master profile. High-level details below — please confirm what else you need to get BrightKey fully enabled for PO issuance.

- Legal name (as it should appear in vendor master): BrightKey Systems, Inc.
- Entity type: C-Corporation (US)
- EIN / Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Registered address: 1412 Meridian Ave, Suite 400, Seattle, WA 98101
- Remit-to address (for check/wire if different): 1412 Meridian Ave, Suite 400, Seattle, WA 98101
- Primary PO contact: Jenna Morris (procure@brightkey.com) — see attached contact sheet
- AP contact: ap@brightkey.com
- Preferred payment method: ACH (bank details to follow via secure DocuSign)

Attachments: BrightKey_W9.pdf (W-9), BrightKey_PO_contact_sheet.xlsx

Can you confirm expected lead time for adding to vendor master and enabling PO creation? Also please tell us what paperwork you need for bank verification (we can sign DocuSign).

Sara
Sara Holden
Head of Operations, BrightKey Systems
procure@brightkey.com

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Holden <sara.holden@brightkey.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightKey vendor setup — initial packet

Hi Sara — thanks for sending these over and for the clear packet. Looping in Karthik from Procurement and Naomi from AP to move this through. Quick clarifying items before we open the vendor record: 

1) Please confirm the legal entity that will appear on invoices (BrightKey Systems, Inc. vs BrightKey LLC). The W-9 you sent lists "BrightKey Systems, Inc." but the purchase order system requires exact match.
2) Confirm whether BrightKey is set up to accept ACH. If yes, we will send a DocuSign bank verification request (secure) — we need a signed authorization + voided check or bank letter.
3) Is the remit-to different for taxes / legal notices? If so, please provide a separate remit mailing address.
4) Please confirm the preferred invoice email address (ap@brightkey.com is listed) and whether you prefer PDF invoices or vendor portal uploads.

Action items for us:
- Karthik will create a provisional vendor record and route for tax validation.
- Naomi will confirm ERP vendor ID once record is created and confirm PO enabling steps.

If you can answer the 4 questions above and sign the DocuSign bank verification, we should be able to enable PO creation within 2 business days after submission.

Thanks,

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

From: Sara Holden <sara.holden@brightkey.com>

Subject: Re: BrightKey vendor setup — initial packet

Hi Olga / Karthik — answers inline below. Forwarding bank instructions as a separate attachment (we'll complete DocuSign as requested).

> 1) Legal entity for invoices
Confirmed: BrightKey Systems, Inc. — please use exact string for the vendor master.

> 2) ACH setup
Yes — ACH preferred. We will complete DocuSign bank verification. We will include a voided check.

> 3) Remit-to
Same as registered address — no separate remit address.

> 4) Invoice email format
Please route invoices to ap@brightkey.com with PDF attachment; we also reconcile via our vendor portal, but email is primary.

Attached: BrightKey_Bank_Instructions.txt (contains masked account info; full details to be completed in DocuSign).

Let us know when the provisional vendor is created and if you need any additional IDs.

Best,
Sara
